kicker: AI AT WORK · STOCK AT EXPIRY RISK
title: Ten SKUs, not *400* lines
subtitle: Cases at risk = stock on hand minus daily sales x days left to sell. Illustrative numbers.
steps: Days left to sell: 75 to expiry minus 45 = 30
prompt:
Per SKU and batch, calculate cases at
risk before customer cut-off. Rank the
top 10 by value at risk. Suggest one
action: transfer, promote or slow production.
tip: Sort by risk, not by age.
warn: Check shelf-life data first. A human signs off every action.

author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages
